annotations.title: Irish used cars whose asking price was recently cut

description: Use to find motivated sellers: listings whose price dropped within the last N days, with original, previous and current price and the percentage cut. Price history is recorded by us from the first time we see a listing. Use get_irish_auto_arbitrage_feed instead for below-market ranking even when there was no recent price cut. Costs 0.02 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

min_drop_pct.description: Minimum size of the latest cut, in percent.
